topic_theme: French Crackdown on Crypto Wrench Attacks

source_articles.title: 88 people charged over 12 crypto wrench attacks in France
France Charges 88, Including Minors, in Crypto ‘Wrench Attack’ Crackdown

combined_key_facts: French law enforcement charged 88 individuals, including minors, in a major crackdown on crypto-related "wrench attacks."
The charges are linked to at least 12 separate attacks where victims were physically threatened or assaulted to force them to reveal their cryptocurrency private keys.
Authorities noted a significant surge in such violent crimes, with 135 crypto-linked incidents reported since 2023.
The investigation revealed that some of the alleged perpetrators were involved in multiple attacks, indicating organized criminal activity.
